Overland AI

Field Infrastructure Engineer

Field Infrastructure Engineer

About Overland AI 

Founded in 2022 and headquartered in Seattle, Washington, Overland AI is transforming land operations for modern defense. The company leverages over a decade of advanced research in robotics and machine learning, as well as a field-test forward ethos, to deliver combined capabilities for unit commanders. Our OverDrive autonomy stack enables ground vehicles to navigate and operate off-road in any terrain without GPS or direct operator control. Our intuitive OverWatch C2 interface provides commanders with precise coordination capabilities essential for mission success.  

Overland AI has secured funding from prominent defense tech investors including 8VC and Point 72, and built trusted partnerships with DARPA, the U.S. Army, Marine Corps, and Special Operations Command. Backed by eight-figure contracts across the Department of Defense, we are strengthening national security by iterating closely with end users engaged in tactical operations.   

Role Summary

We are looking for a field-forward infrastructure engineer to help deploy, configure, operate and iterate on autonomous ground-vehicle support systems across real operational environments – military exercises, customer demonstrations, test sites and integration events. This role spans infrastructure, software delivery, networking, and automation. 

This is not a desk-only role. You may spend up to 50% of your time deployed at test sites, military installations, and operational events, standing up networks, diagnosing issues under pressure, and integrating our systems with partner platforms and customer infrastructure.

You'll come from a background of network or system administration, DevOps, SRE or similar. You will be fluent with Linux, wired and wireless networking. When you are not traveling you will help with other projects including cloud and on-premise infrastructure, CI/CD, improving our security posture, and automation tooling. This position reports to the Head of Infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

Deploy and manage supporting infrastructure — including compute, observability, and logging — to improve reliability and incident response in field environments.
Deploy and administer Linux-based servers and edge compute platforms in field and datacenter environments, service management, containers, and virtual machines.
Deploy, configure, and sustain tactical mesh networks using Silvus or Persistent Systems radios and similar mesh networking platforms across field exercises and operational events.
Configure and operate SD-WAN and adaptive networking solutions.
Integrate networking infrastructure across multi-vendor, multi-domain environments — connecting autonomous systems, cloud relays, and partner platforms into cohesive network architectures.
Manage VPNs, tunnels, and jump hosts across distributed field sites.
Troubleshoot and resolve networking, RF, and system-integration issues during live deployments, often under time pressure and in resource-constrained environments.
Document network architectures, field performance, integration lessons learned, and provide actionable recommendations to improve operational readiness.
Act as an on-site technical expert, training operators and partner teams on network behavior, limitations, and troubleshooting procedures.
Partner with software, hardware, and autonomy engineers to ensure seamless network integration aligned with mission requirements.
Build infrastructure and automation using Terraform, Ansible, and Python to improve developer productivity and operational efficiency.  

Minimum Qualifications

3+ years of experience in network engineering, systems engineering, field communications, or systems integration in defense, robotics, or related operational environments.
Experience deploying and troubleshooting Linux-based systems in field environments.
Hands-on experience with tactical mesh radio systems.
Experience with SD-WAN or adaptive networking platforms.
In-depth understanding of networking, security, and observability concepts, including VPNs, firewalls, routing, logging, and monitoring.  
Experience deploying and operating AWS infrastructure and supporting Linux-based production systems.  
Ability to operate independently in challenging environments, including adverse weather, remote locations, and resource-constrained settings.
Experience with infrastructure as code tools such as ansible or terraform.
Proficiency in Bash, Python, Go, Rust, or similar programming languages to build internal tooling and automation. 

Additional Requirements 

Frequent travel (up to 50%) including time at test sites, customer locations, and operational event both in US and across the world.
Ability to work onsite hybrid at our office locations when not traveling
Ability to participate in 24x7 on-call rotation
Ability to obtain and maintain a Security Clearance

Location:
This position is located in Seattle, WA.  Frequent, extended travel is expected (>50%), including time at test sites, customer locations, and operational events, both CONUS and OCONUS. 

The compensation for this role is 

Field Infrastructure Engineer I:  $116,000 - $150,000 annually 

Field Infrastructure Engineer II: $148,000 - $189,000 annually 

Actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Benefits

Overland AI believes in creating a work environment that you look forward to embracing every day. 

Benefits include:

Equity compensation
Best-in-class healthcare, dental and vision plans 
Flexible PTO
401k with company match
Parental leave
One-time workplace & productivity reimbursement

Overland AI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, marital status, disability, genetic information, protected veteran or military status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

This position may involve access to export-controlled technology. Employment is contingent on the ability to comply with U.S. export control laws.

Overland AI provides reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans during the application process. Please contact peopleops@overland.ai to request an accommodation.
